name: Liana of Minorad
description: A planeswalker and one of the Sages of Minorad who holds three Moxes and sends herself and Ravidel into the Abyss.

timeline.summary: Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.
timeline.quote: Liana gave them to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel at Minorad so that he would not take them.

citation.text: "Mox", section "Moxen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arathoxia is built with the aid of Liana of Minorad and the Scarlet Vizier.
timeline.quote: Arathoxia was built with the aid of Liana of Minorad and the Scarlet Vizier .

citation.text: "Arathoxia", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel conquers Arathoxia; Jared steals the Lotus, leads refugees against Ravidel at Castle Melmereth and summons a Shivan Dragon.
timeline.quote: Ravidel tracked Jared down and conquered Arathoxia

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared learns Ravidel is alive; Liana dies; Ravidel activates the Mox Beacon starting the Planeswalker War.
timeline.quote: activated the Mox Beacon that would start the Planeswalker War

citation.text: "Jared Carthalion", section "Confrontation and ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The greatest magical minds of Dominaria assemble at Minorad in 3000 AR, forming the Sages of Minorad.
timeline.quote: the first formal convening of the Sages of Minorad

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana is forced into servitude under the Scarlet Vizier.
timeline.quote: Liana of Minorad was forced into servitude under the Scarlet Vizier

citation.text: "The Gathering", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Great Spirit reveals that Ravidel is alive and hunting Liana and her Moxes.
timeline.quote: It reveals to Jared that Ravidel is alive and is hunting Liana of Minorad and her three Moxes

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 2: Forces of Nature". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared abandons Kristina and heads north to save Liana.
timeline.quote: he immediately abandons her and heads north to save Liana from Ravidel.

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 2: Forces of Nature". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel duels Liana for her Moxes and reveals his master is Taysir.
timeline.quote: He reveals to her that his Master is Taysir

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana gives Jared her Moxes and sends herself and Ravidel into the Abyss.
timeline.quote: She then casts a spell to send herself and Ravidel into the Abyss

citation.text: "Wayfarer", section "Volume 3: Patterns in Chaos". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scarlet Vizier rebuffs Ezer at the Carthalion estate while Liana, disguised as a child, watches.
timeline.quote: is rebuffed by the Scarlet Vizier , who calls him a liar and throws him and the infant into the street

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 1: The Aster Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared steals the Black Lotus, learns of his mother, and with Liana escapes the baths; Ravidel beats Jared back until Liana reveals three Moxes and Ravidel leaves.
timeline.quote: Liana reveals she has three Moxes , giving her the upper hand in a duel.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 2: Desolate Angel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks Arathoxia with juggernauts and a Chaos Orb that annihilates Bikov and the port; the Scarlet Vizier dies telling Jared his mother was murdered and frees Liana; Ravidel kills Verdenth.
timeline.quote: With his last breath, the vizier releases Liana from his indentured servitude.

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 3: War Child". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Freed by the vizier's death, Liana is able to act against Ravidel and enters the castle with Ezer.
timeline.quote: this newly discovered freedom from her oath finally enables Liana to take direct action against Ravidel

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Narok kills Nikko and Jared annihilates Narok, then crushes the Black Lotus to summon a Shivan Dragon that destroys the castle; Ezer dies, and the castle explodes from Liana's sorcery.
timeline.quote: Jared crushes the Black Lotus and summons a Shivan Dragon

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared and Liana share a kiss and he leaves to learn new magic and become a Wayfarer.
timeline.quote: Jared and Liana share a kiss

citation.text: "The Shadow Mage", section "Volume 4: First Duel". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel attacks the Summit of Minorad and uses the Sylex to blackmail several planeswalkers into servitude.
timeline.quote: Ravidel attacked this Summit of Minorad and hatched an insidious plan

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "The summit of Minorad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana and Altair die at Ravidel's hands, and he secures the Moxes.
timeline.quote: died at Ravidel's hands

citation.text: "Ravidel", section "Gathering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana arrives at Master Ozbolt's lab and meets Florin, who asks her to call him by his first name; they discuss her philosophy and she becomes his apprentice.
timeline.quote: I think I'm exactly where I should be.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liana and Florin test a mimetic ooze limb-replacement therapy on rats, including Subject 23.
timeline.quote: Liana dipped a swab into the vial of ooze in front of her

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Florin tells Liana the story of an Izzet chemister who died using her neural chronaccelerator, and asks whether she did the right thing.
timeline.quote: A few hours later, she was dead.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Florin warns that improving yourself may change you in disturbing ways.
timeline.quote: When you seek to improve the world around you, you start by improving yourself.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Subject 23's ooze graft grows, and Florin declares them ready to begin.
timeline.quote: In that case," he said, "I'd say we're finally ready to begin.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liana returns to find the lab dark and Florin missing, and an ooze vat moves.
timeline.quote: Then the ooze in one of the vats... moved.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Florin has remade himself as an ooze creature and says he has bettered himself.
timeline.quote: I have bettered myself.

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Florin invites Liana to remake herself in the vat; she flees the lab.
timeline.quote: She turned and stumbled through the darkened lab

citation.text: "Experiment One". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Liana visits Florin's lab and becomes his apprentice.
timeline.quote: he accepted her as his apprentice.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Florin and Liana develop a limb-replacement therapy using a mimetic ooze on injured rats.
timeline.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy, using injured rats to test results.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Florin argues for experimenting on oneself and asks if Liana is ready; she reluctantly agrees.
timeline.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A rat's ooze-graft grows, and Florin announces he is ready for Experiment One.
timeline.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana finds the lab abandoned and the ooze in the tank moving; it launches out of the vat.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, the ooze launched itself out of the vat, and Liana jumped back, shouting for her master.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The ooze is revealed to have taken Florin's shape; he has transformed himself.
timeline.quote: The ooze had taken Florin's shape, just as it had taken the shape of the rats' missing limbs.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Florin tells Liana he has bettered himself and that humanity's real problem is its frail organs.
timeline.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees.
timeline.quote: but she turned and ran, out of the lab and beyond, and she did not look back.

citation.text: "Florin Ozbolt", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana becomes Florin Ozbolt's apprentice after Florin seems to agree with her philosophy of using Simic power to improve lives.
timeline.quote: Master Florin seemed to agree and thus accepted her as an apprentice.

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana and Florin test a limb-replacement therapy on rats with a mimetic ooze.
timeline.quote: The pair spent their first time together working on an innovative limb-replacement therapy

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They debate ethics of self-experimentation, and Liana reluctantly agrees to its nobility.
timeline.quote: Florin asked Liana if she was ready for such a thing, and she reluctantly agreed.

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The rat's ooze-graft succeeds, and Florin prepares to proceed with Experiment One.
timeline.quote: The scientist was now ready to proceed with the cryptic test that he called Experiment One .

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana returns to find the lab abandoned and the ooze in the tank moving; it leaps from the vat.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, the ooze launched itself out of the vat

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana realizes the ooze has taken Florin's shape, and Florin speaks, saying he has bettered himself.
timeline.quote: he told her he had bettered himself, just as they had spoken of in their debates

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Florin urges Liana to enter the vat; she flees the lab.
timeline.quote: She kept running, and she did not look back.

citation.text: "Liana (Ravnica)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana of Minorad summons the cage to contain Jared Carthalion.
timeline.quote: it was summoned by Liana of Minorad to contain Jared Carthalion

citation.text: "Barl's Cage", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jared allies with Yorgo and Nikko, learns of Liana of Minorad from the dying vizier, and rescues Ezer from scathe zombies.
timeline.quote: Jared and his team of urchins killed the undead and rescued the old spellsquire

citation.text: "Fall of Arathoxia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana of Minorad intervenes in Jared's near-duel with Ravidel and cages him while Ravidel destroys the sultan's palace.
timeline.quote: Liana of Minorad intervened in the near-duel, locking Jared away in a cage while Ravidel went on to destroy the sultan's palace.

citation.text: "Fall of Arathoxia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arathoxia is left a ruin; the sultan, the Lord of House Khone, Jared and Liana escape, and Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel.
timeline.quote: Jared swore vengeance against Ravidel, seeking retribution for the loss of his parents and his shattered home.

citation.text: "Fall of Arathoxia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana leads survivors out and detonates the remaining artifacts, reducing the castle to rubble.
timeline.quote: reducing Castle Melmereth to rubble

citation.text: "Fall of Castle Melmereth", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel survives but loses control of Corondor; Jared departs as a Wayfarer.
timeline.quote: his control over Corondor was shattered

citation.text: "Fall of Castle Melmereth", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ravidel interrupts a summit of mages and planeswalkers, threatening them with the Golgothian Sylex.
timeline.quote: This gathering was interrupted by Ravidel

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Scarlet Vizier mind-controls Liana, forcing her to become Ravidel's lover.
timeline.quote: cast a mind control spell on her, so she couldn't fight Ravidel and was forced to become his lover instead

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana helps Jared escape Castle Melmereth.
timeline.quote: she helped Jared escape Castle Melmereth

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Vizier dies at Arathoxia, Liana allies with Jared and detonates Ravidel's artifacts.
timeline.quote: Liana allied herself with Jared and detonated all of Ravidel's artifacts

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Liana lures Ravidel into the Abyss so Jared and Kristina can escape to Corundis; she dies in the battle.
timeline.quote: Liana died in the battle

citation.text: "Liana of Minorad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
